snippets.snippet: Revised 06/27/2019 Page 2 of 2 PRIVATE GENERAL SPECIFICATIONS: 1. All construction must comply with the Scioto County Engineer Standards and the specifications set forth by the Scioto County Engineer. 2. Trenches and bore pits shall be backfilled per trench restoration standards of the Scioto County Engineer. Trenches and bore pits closer than five (5) feet from the edge of any road surface will not be permitted without special permission and conditions from the County Engineer. All trenches and bore pits shall be backfilled and restored as closely as possible to completion of excavation and safe protection of trench and pit shall be maintained. 3. The distance from the edge of the pavement to the near edge of the trench shall be equal to or greater than the depth of the trench.
